apps.name: Saber
apps.subtitle: Open-source handwritten notes
apps.localizedDescription: Saber is a free and open-source handwritten notes app built with Flutter. Write with your finger or Apple Pencil as if on paper, organize notes into folders, keep them private with encryption, and sync across devices using its optional Nextcloud-based sync — no vendor lock-in.
